stories.title: Global Microsoft outage knocks out Outlook and other services
stories.label: Global Microsoft IT Outage

reports.text: On 13 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/que-fallo-en-la-caida-de-microsoft-las-claves-en-las-24-horas-de-trabajos-de-recuperacion-33118843) reported that Microsoft attributed the global service outage to a failure during a prior capacity expansion and stated that services are generally recovering.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide) reported that Microsoft Outlook, Teams, and Copilot experienced a major global outage affecting users worldwide.

On 13 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/cqx2e0pl80gro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/outage-in-microsoft-services-affects-tens-of-thousands-of-users-9yx9g5w) reported that tens of thousands of users suffered disruptions to Microsoft's online services.

On 13 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/microsoft-outage-improvements-for-outlook-and-other-services-around-globe/PZYAOUDJKVAIRBOIGXZLIOYQMA/) reported that Microsoft achieved a broad recovery for Outlook and other global services, while visa processing, property settlements, and courts experienced disruptions.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/microsoft-atribuye-caida-global-de-sus-servicios-a-un-fallo-tecnico-anuncia-una-recuperacion-generalizada/) reported that Microsoft attributed the global service outage to a technical flaw and announced a general recovery while ruling out cybersecurity issues.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/caida-microsoft-expone-riesgo-fallos-cascada-integracion-servicios_1794596886) reported that the service interruption began at midday on Thursday and lasted more than 20 hours.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/england-health-service-triggers-contingency-microsoft-outage.1137044) reported that England's health service triggered contingency plans due to the Microsoft outage affecting Outlook and Teams.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-says-day-long-outage-triggered-by-technical-issue-rules-out-role-of-ai-cyber-agents-101794589974056.html) reported that Microsoft stated a technical issue caused the day-long outage and ruled out the role of AI and cyber agents.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/panne-chez-microsoft-le-recit-de-24-heures-de-pagaille-dans-les-entreprises-les-hopitaux-et-les-gouvernements-du-monde-entier-20261113) reported that millions of users in enterprises, hospitals, and governments were affected by the 24-hour Microsoft outage.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044258/microsoft-deeply-sorry-as-outage-triggers-global-chaos), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/article/3374408/microsoft-deeply-sorry-global-outage-says-issue-not-caused-cyber-or-ai-agents), [Punch](https://punchng.com/microsoft-apologises-as-global-outage-disrupts-services-in-74-countries/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Microsoft apologized for the global outage and reported a broad recovery for Outlook.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/microsoft-deeply-sorry-hourslong-outage-impacts-74-countries.1137079) reported that the outage impacted 74 countries, disrupting healthcare services, corporate earnings reports, and schools.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/avanza-recuperacion-de-servicios-de-microsoft-en-norteamerica-y-europa-persisten-problemas-de-acceso/) reported that the recovery of Microsoft services in North America and Europe advanced while access problems persisted.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/13/microsoft-outage-hits-nhs-hospitals-gps-schools-and-police-across-uk) reported that the Microsoft outage caused serious and widespread disruption across the UK, affecting hospitals, general practitioners, schools, and police.

On 13 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/microsoft-rules-out-malicious-activity-as-cause-for-global-outage/a-79935611?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/microsoft-seeing-improvements-outage-causes-global-chaos.1137057) reported that Microsoft stated it was not aware of any malicious activity causing the global outage.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/microsoft-outage-today-latest-outlook-teams-down-openai-fixed-b3084265.html) reported that Microsoft stated attempts to fix the outage affecting Outlook and Teams were not going as expected.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/13/first-thing-global-microsoft-outage-chaos-signs-of-stabilisation) reported that users of Microsoft Teams and Outlook in businesses and public services reported problems, while the tech firm noted signs of stabilisation.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/portugal-government-schools-and-health-services-hit-by-global-microsoft-outage) reported that a global Microsoft outage disrupted sectors in Portugal, hindering access to Outlook and Teams.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/microsoft-descarta-ciberataque-tras-caida-mundial-de-outlook-atribuye-paron-a-una-carga-elevada-en-su-infraestructura/), [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/caida-mundial-de-outlook-microsoft-descarta-un-ciberataque) reported that Microsoft ruled out a cyberattack after a global Outlook outage and attributed the stoppage to high load.

On 13 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/tecnologia/problemas-con-outlook-hoy-reportan-una-falla-a-nivel-mundial-y-sigue-sin-funcionar-el-correo-de-nid13112026/) La Nación reported that a general service drop affected Microsoft 365, including Outlook email, OneDrive online storage, and the office package.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/future/technology/2026/11/13/microsoft-outlook-outage-update/) The National reported that Microsoft is continuing to work on the Outlook email problem with partial recovery seen in some regions.
On 13 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2217845) reported that Microsoft announced gradual traffic recovery after a server failure.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El País](https://english.elpais.com/technology/2026-11-13/microsoft-fails-to-restore-services-after-more-than-12-hours-of-global-disruption.html) reported that an executive stated a cyberattack is unlikely to be behind the global Microsoft disruptions affecting email, AI, and other applications.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-outage-disrupts-global-financial-markets-and-trading-desks-forces-traders-to-use-phones-101794556388573.html) reported that the Microsoft outage disrupted financial markets and trading desks, forcing traders to use phones and WhatsApp.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/microsoft-outage-disrupts-uk-health-services-delays-patient-referrals/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that a union warned the Microsoft outage impacted Britain's National Health Service by delaying patient referrals and prescriptions.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/microsoft-outage-disrupts-colorado-jail-bond-payments-delays-release-of-prisoners-101794562136835.html) reported that a global Microsoft service disruption affected online bond payments at the Arapahoe County Detention Facility in Colorado.
On 13 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2217693) reported that Charles Lamanna stated the widespread Microsoft services outage was not caused by a cyberattack.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/microsoft-outage-hits-outlook-teams-worldwide-draws-130000-us-reports/) reported that a major outage disrupted email, workplace communications and business operations worldwide, drawing 130,000 US reports.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/en-direct-panne-mondiale-de-microsoft-et-d-outlook-les-difficultes-se-poursuivent-de-lourdes-consequences-rapportees-dans-le-monde-20261113) reported that Microsoft mentioned progressive improvements for some customers while noting ongoing difficulties.

On 12 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/business/2026/1112/1599052-microsoft/), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/microsoft-reports-connectivity-disruptions-affecting-multiple-regions-worldwide/) reported that thousands of Microsoft users worldwide experienced service disruptions and connectivity issues across multiple regions.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/pixels/article/2026/11/13/une-panne-mondiale-d-outlook-empeche-des-dizaines-de-milliers-d-utilisateurs-d-acceder-a-leurs-e-mails_6809171_4408996.html) reported that Microsoft stated there was no sign of malicious action or cyberattack during the worldwide Outlook messaging outage.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/entreprises-paralysees-examens-perturbes-avions-retardes-la-panne-mondiale-de-microsoft-et-outlook-provoque-des-consequences-en-cascade-20261113) reported that the Microsoft and Outlook outage caused cascading disruptions including paralyzed businesses, delayed exams, and delayed flights.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/tech-and-start-ups/article-914812) reported that experts ruled out a cyberattack and explained the disruption as a suspected server failure.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxPQWpWeUZnbllhcFk4WktZS0s3T1N6T3k3Vnhhd3pfSE9SWF9iRmRIQUljdHZXN0UtWS1uZS1rbUNZSlVPd1NXLXRtVUVtc3NQNTgxMVFMWjVnT3pPb09EX1g1YUx3WkF2VHk0bUMwWlhkRHdpT0JFRE5SQ3pQRkdmSnpUOHNXLUo1dXNSY3lFdkpSdU5laDdwSlhWRDVnNjBFcUh2Y0FwMXNldE8tSFpPaw?oc=5), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/future/technology/2026/11/13/microsoft-outlook-outage-update/) reported that a Microsoft outage spilled into Asia-Pacific business hours with a partial recovery seen in some regions.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/solucionado-caida-microsoft-outlook-teams-siguen-funcionar-hoy-ia-claude-sufre-graves-errores-inicio-sesion_0_WJwBFsZGfY.html) reported that the Claude AI platform experienced login errors during the Microsoft disruption.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/microsoft-se-cae-a-nivel-mundial-outlook-y-teams-estan-afectados-33100651) reported that Microsoft stated the global service outage is due to a high load in its infrastructure across several regions.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/outlook-suma-mas-de-5-horas-sin-funcionar-persiste-caida-del-servicio-de-microsoft/) reported that Downdetector monitors showed about 130,000 users reported problems with Outlook.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/tecnologia/2026-11-13/microsoft-no-logra-recuperar-sus-servicios-tras-una-caida-global-de-mas-de-12-horas.html) reported that a company executive discarded any cyberattack behind the failures affecting Outlook, Teams, and AI platforms.

On 13 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/microsoft-rules-out-malicious-activity-as-cause-for-global-outage/a-79935611?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261113-microsoft-faces-a-major-outlook-outage-no-signs-of-a-cyberattack) reported that Microsoft ruled out malicious activity as the cause of the global outage.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/microsoft-battling-global-outlook-microsoft-365-outage), [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/outlook-outage-hits-users-in-74-countries-as-microsoft-seeks-fix/) reported that the disruption hit Microsoft products in 74 countries and territories.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/outlook-outage-hits-users-in-74-countries-as-microsoft-seeks-fix/) reported that repair efforts were not going as expected and the firm was seeking alternative solutions.

stories.title: Israel hits Gaza's Nasser Hospital in deadly strike
stories.label: Gaza: Severe Storms and Floods Damage Displaced Persons Tents

reports.text: On 13 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-un-warns-israeli-attacks-have-pushed-gazas-health-system-to-brink-of-collapse/) reported that the UN warned that years of Israeli attacks have pushed Gaza's health system to the brink of collapse.

On 13 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/793-attacks-gaza-hospitals-kill-1725/) reported that Israel has carried out 793 attacks on Gaza's health services since October 2023, killing more than 1,700 health workers.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/who-warns-gaza-flooding-could-trigger-surge-in-respiratory-illnesses/) reported that floodwaters sweeping through Gaza tent camps after heavy rains are setting the stage for a sharper spike in respiratory illness.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532097/Six-including-a-surgeon-killed-in-Israeli-strike-on-Nasser), a state-media outlet, reported that an Israeli airstrike on Gaza's Nasser Hospital killed six people and injured 27 others.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/respiratory-illnesses-rise-gaza-worst-come-winter-floods-arrive-who-says), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/middle-east/2026/1113/1599114-israel-gaza/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581076/who-warns-respiratory-infections-surge-in-gaza-as-winter-approaches/) reported that the World Health Organization warned of surging respiratory illnesses in Gaza as winter floods arrive.
On 13 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2217837) reported that the Board of Peace urged immediate action on Donald Trump's Gaza plan following a hospital strike.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-israeli-strike-on-vehicle-outside-wedding-hall-kills-one-palestinian-in-central-gaza/) reported that an Israeli strike on a vehicle outside a wedding hall killed one person in Deir al-Balah.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/53-nations-demand-urgent-aid-access-as-gaza-baby-freezes-to-death) reported that 53 countries and organizations urged Israel to allow unrestricted humanitarian aid into the Gaza Strip as a nine-month-old baby froze to death.

On 13 Nov 2026, [La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/13/mundo/028n1mun?partner=rss) reported that the Israeli army attacked Nasser hospital for the seventh time, killing at least seven Palestinians.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-hamas-says-board-of-peace-adopts-misleading-israeli-narrative-on-gaza-hospitals/) reported that Hamas strongly rejected the Board of Peace's adoption of what it called a misleading Israeli narrative regarding the use of Gaza hospitals for military command.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/202897/%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B0-%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D8%B9%D8%AF-%D8%B6%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%B4%D9%81%D9%89-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1/) reported that the Peace Council in Gaza stated that the human casualties from the Israeli strike on Nasser hospital in Khan Younis confirm the need to implement Trump's peace plan immediately.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190048/11-%D8%B4%D9%87%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A7-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%8A%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B5%D9%84-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AF%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86) reported that 10 citizens were martyred in Israeli attacks on the Gaza Strip, including six who died in a strike targeting Nasser Complex.

On 12 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/israel-strikes-gaza-hospital-says-hamas-senior-figure-inside/a-79927645?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Israel stated Hamas was using the hospital as a military command center.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190087/%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%B2-%D8%AD%D9%82%D9%88%D9%82%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%AD%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%AC%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%A1%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88) reported that the 'Himaya' human rights center condemned the targeting of the surgical department at Nasser Medical Complex as a war crime.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/12/israeli-airstrike-nasser-hospital-gaza-kills-surgeon) reported that an Israeli airstrike on Nasser hospital in Gaza killed a surgeon and five others, including patients awaiting surgery.

On 12 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/israel-targets-senior-hamas-member-in-gaza-hospital-strike/a-79927645?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/israel-afirma-que-objetivo-bombardeo-hospital-era-comandante-hamas_202611126af597d74196933d7eda7a4c.html) reported that Israel stated the target of its strike on a hospital was a Hamas commander named Muhamad abu Ismail.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190073/%D9%86%D8%B9%D9%8A%D9%85-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%83-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1) reported that Hamas political bureau member Basem Naim held Israel and the Peace Council responsible for targeting the Nasser Medical Complex.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/israeli-strike-on-gazas-nasser-hospital-kills-6-including-doctor) reported that an Israeli airstrike on southern Gaza's Nasser Hospital killed at least six people, including a surgeon, according to Palestinian health authorities.

reports.text: On 12 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr894w453e90o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that schools across Italy received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking evacuations.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovi-allarmi-bomba-in-3.800-scuole-ma-si-resta-in-classe_8e554317-0de6-4431-82f1-76e9da9afb9d.html) reported that new bomb alarms hit 3,800 schools in Italy while classes continued.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQSFJJaFJoR2JHVWdTZmVzdkw2MDhTc29qU0pDRmdmaXpwWjN2Q3VyYjlFUWJkRmJHTmlaNFFYdWIxdTFHR3p5VGlTaGExYzFwZ3BTRjV6dTJuQWdibllJN1lwd3E1RThuUEU2ekpfbU1GSUJwU2tyMkd5a3daSEkwNm5YU19zUEIxLWpSNjNDS0lzT1NCd2ZQRG1COA?oc=5), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/italian-schools-hit-by-fresh-bomb-threats-premiers-office-targeted-3725511) reported that Italian schools remained open despite a fresh wave of email bomb threats that led to evacuations and security inspections in several regions.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/italy-hit-by-second-day-of-school-bomb-threats-as-meloni-summons-opposition) reported that bomb threats hit schools in Italy and France, and French President Emmanuel Macron stated it is too soon to blame foreign powers.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/politica/2026/11/12/nel-pomeriggio-riunione-tecnica-sul-protocollo-di-gestione-degli-allarmi_935b5bfb-8d1b-47fb-b1f5-5bec809755af.html) reported that an official circular was issued to schools stating that evacuations should not occur in the absence of concrete dangers, while prefects retain the authority to order them.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovo-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-controlli-e-evacuazioni-liveblog_97a3c6b7-93f4-44a2-940b-dd33198f2f91.html) reported that a new bomb alarm hit schools across various regions via emails signed by Mikhail Andropov.

On 11 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-in-oltre-6000-scuole-in-italia-evacuazioni-e-controlli.-meloni-grande_870b0024-72d2-4b15-bab5-0c74dcc1d653.html) reported that false bomb threats sent via an anonymous email led to evacuations and controls in over 6,000 schools in Italy.

On 11 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwz0k79pr8z2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that false warnings containing bomb threats were sent via email to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste, and other Italian cities.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/vuelven-evacuar-cientos-escuelas-italia-falsas-amenazas-bomba-segunda-vez-mes_0_7GXzyxNE7g.html) reported that hundreds of schools in Italy were evacuated for the second time in less than a month following anonymous emails containing bomb threats directed at principals.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/crisis-en-paraguay-fiscalia-pide-ampliar-la-imputacion-contra-el-expresidente-santiago-pena-y-lo-acusa-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal-3600892), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-fiscalia-de-paraguay-complica-la-situacion-de-pena-con-una-nueva-imputacion-por-asociacion-nid13112026/), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fiscalia-acusa-a-expresidente-paraguayo-de-liderar-asociacion-criminal-santiago-pena-protegio-desde-el-poder-a-ueno-bank-senala/) reported that the Paraguayan prosecutor's office expanded charges against former president Santiago Peña, accusing him of leading a criminal association and protecting Ueno Bank from power.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/santiago-pena-palacios-presidente-de-paraguay-sigue-la-pauta-destituido-y-en-la-carcel/) reported that regulators seized Ueno Bank, which managed about 850 million dollars in public funds.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-adds-prosecutors-ueno-bank-pena-investigations/) reported that Paraguay's attorney general Emiliano Rolón added two prosecutors to the Ueno Bank and Santiago Peña investigations.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-de-paraguay-allana-la-residencia-presidencial-por-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-33098347) reported that the Paraguayan justice system is carrying out two parallel investigations, one focused on Ueno Bank executives, 10 of whom are detained.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/paraguay-detienen-al-superintendente-de-bancos-por-caso-ueno-bank) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks was detained in connection with the Ueno Bank case following reports by prosecutors regarding operations without guarantees.

On 12 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/12/paraguay-s-banking-superintendent-arrested-in-the-ueno-bank-investigation?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/caso-ueno-bank-detuvieron-superintendente-bancos-paraguay_0_haEsfgaxKm.html) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks, Holger Insfrán, was arrested as part of the investigation into Ueno Bank.

On 11 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/ahorristas-bolivianos-ueno-bank-pueden-perder-12-dinero-tipo-cambio_1794364395) reported that Sergio León, director of the Bolivian-Paraguayan Chamber of Commerce, stated that Bolivian depositors in Ueno Bank can lose between up to 12% of their money due to the exchange rate.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/seguridad-social-paraguay-denuncia-ueno-bank-516-millones-dolares_1794351537) reported that Paraguay's social security denounced Ueno Bank for more than 516 million dollars, with President Pedro Alliana confirming the return of funds to public sector contributors.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/gobernante-partido-colorado-expulsa-santiago-pena-escandalo-ueno-bank_1794351056) reported that the ruling Colorado Party expelled Santiago Peña after the Ueno bank scandal.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/video-explica-crise-politica-e-bancaria-que-abala-o-paraguai-e-derrubou-presidente.shtml) reported that Paraguay is facing a political and financial crisis following the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left approximately 3 million clients affected.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/banco-central-revela-que-devolvio-ahorros-al-93-de-los-clientes-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-investigacion-continua/) reported that the Central Bank of Paraguay announced it returned savings to 93 percent of Ueno Bank clients while investigations continue.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/caso-ueno-deja-7-senales-alerta-vigilar-salud-bancos_1794326171) reported that banking expert Fabián Chaín warned that the Ueno case leaves seven warning signs to monitor the health of banks.
